scope: Independent read-only source review; Root owns native execution and fixes.

findings.title: Invalidate face provenance when the same concave resource changes
findings.detail: The mapping is bound only to shape instance ID and stored face count/ranges. ConcavePolygonShape3D.set_faces can replace/reorder the triangles inside that same resource. After a same-instance reordering across two source-way ranges, the resolver can accept a new native face_index but return the old source-way/face assignment. The existing replacement-resource test does not cover this. Detect the installed resource generation changing once, then reject its mapping in O(1); avoid rehashing large faces on every player/support query. Root should validate the actual change notification and native behavior rather than assume it.
findings.requested_native_evidence: Build aggregate with multiple ways, mutate same shape instance triangle order across way boundary, verify fresh native ray no longer receives stale source provenance; preserve old resource-ID replacement, split-range, loop-hole, shape-index, disabled/free checks.

reviewed_as_correct: New mode opt-in; previous default retained.
All source row geometry/indices checked before adding scene nodes.
Triangle triples are copied in exact original order; split ranges carry original source_first_face across batches.
Visual positions, normals, UV and indices remain the same aggregate arrays.
Fixed per-body faces and per-tile face/vertex bounds remain.
Native shape owner, RID, space, resource replacement and origin revision are checked before range resolution.
Synthetic QA compares actual triangle byte arrays, render arrays and original-way ray results across default/batched/split layouts; a real loop hole is retained.
unproven: Actual country chunk integration and traversal
Main-thread construction cost and representative rendered frame timing
nonblocking_observation: build_physical still creates a transient per-feature ArrayMesh in static_batches mode although only the previous per_feature branch uses its trimesh conversion. Removing unused transient allocations could reduce setup cost without affecting representation, but native correctness comes first.
